Anatomical illustration

Mia uses custom vector geometry for the skull, vertebrae, curved ribs, pelvis and limb bones. Forearms and lower legs show paired bones. The overlay is fitted to detected pose joints and interpolated during playback.

This is an approximate 2D anatomical illustration, not a medical scan or reconstruction of the person's actual bones.

Pose detection uses Google's MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.21 and Pose Landmarker Heavy model. MediaPipe is licensed under Apache 2.0. See the repository's licenses directory.
